newsitem.title: USA: Alpha-Beta sees Q2 charge for MycoTox deal.
newsitem.headline: Alpha-Beta sees Q2 charge for MycoTox deal.

text.p: Alpha-Beta Technology Inc said Tuesday it had closed its previously announced acquisition of Denver-based MycoTox Inc and will take a charge against second quarter operating results from the deal.
The charge, which the company did not specify, will stem from the write-off of acquired in-process research and development, Alpha-Beta said.
The transaction will be recorded as a purchase for accounting purposes, it added.
Alpha-Beta made an initial payment of 56,813 shares of common stock and about $500,000 cash for MycoTox, it said.
It said it will issue another 113,630 shares on June 9, plus up to an additional $1.0 million of stock subject to the attainment of certain performance milestones.
